hook.situation: Your team has a deadline today. You cannot cancel, you do not believe anyone will give up, and only one realistic method remains.
objectives: Use -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 for a no-choice situation.
Use -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 to strongly reject a possibility.
Use -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다 or N뿐이다 to limit the situation to only one action or option.
hook.whyItMatters: English learners often say 'I can't' when they mean 'I have no choice but to.' Korean separates inability, inevitability, disbelief, and only-option nuance very clearly.

grammarNotes.title: V-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 — no choice but to
grammarNotes.mentalModel: This pattern says the situation has cornered you into one option. You can do it, but there is no realistic alternative.
grammarNotes.formation: Vowel stems take -ㄹ 수밖에 없다: 가다 → 갈 수밖에 없다. Consonant stems take -을 수밖에 없다: 먹다 → 먹을 수밖에 없다. ㄹ-stems drop ㄹ: 만들다 → 만들 수밖에 없다.

examples.en: The deadline is today, so we have no choice but to work late.

examples.ko: 자료는 맞지만 설명은 다시 쓸 수밖에 없어요.
examples.romanization: jaryoneun matjiman seolmyeongeun dasi sseul subakke eopseoyo.
examples.en: The data is right, but we have no choice but to rewrite the explanation.
examples.note: Only one repair path is left.

examples.ko: 규칙이 바뀌어서 계획을 다시 세울 수밖에 없었어요.
examples.romanization: gyuchigi bakkwieoseo gyehoegeul dasi seul subakke eopseosseoyo.
examples.en: The rule changed, so we had no choice but to make the plan again.

exceptions: Do not confuse it with -(으)ㄹ 수 없다. 갈 수 없어요 means 'I cannot go'; 갈 수밖에 없어요 means 'I have no choice but to go.'
수밖에 is written together in this fixed expression.

grammarNotes.title: V-(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 — no way that is true
grammarNotes.mentalModel: 리가 없다 rejects a possibility because it does not fit what you know, believe, or expect.
grammarNotes.formation: Vowel stems take -ㄹ 리가 없다: 오다 → 올 리가 없다. Consonant stems take -을 리가 없다: 먹다 → 먹을 리가 없다. Past uses -았/었을 리가 없다. Nouns use N일 리가 없다.

examples.en: There is no way we would give up now.
examples.note: Strongly rejects the possibility of giving up.

examples.ko: 그 사람이 마감을 잊었을 리가 없어요.
examples.romanization: geu sarami magameul ijeosseul riga eopseoyo.
examples.en: There is no way that person forgot the deadline.
There is no way this data is wrong.
examples.note: Strong confidence based on what the speaker knows.

exceptions: 리가 없다 is stronger than probably not. For a softer guess, use 아마 아닐 거예요 or -(으)ㄹ지도 몰라요.
Do not use 방법이 없다 for this meaning. 방법이 없다 means there is no method.

grammarNotes.title: V-(으)ㄹ 뿐이다 / N뿐이다 — only, nothing more
grammarNotes.mentalModel: 뿐이다 closes the statement: this is all there is, and nothing else is being added.
grammarNotes.formation: Verbs take -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다: 기다릴 뿐이에요. Past uses -았/었을 뿐이다: 도와줬을 뿐이에요. Nouns attach directly: 방법뿐이에요, 친구일 뿐이에요.

examples.en: In the end, this method is the only thing left.
For now, all we can do is wait.

exceptions: 뿐이다 means only. 뿐만 아니라 means not only but also, so it opens the sentence in the opposite direction.
만 narrows a noun or object; -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다 can narrow the whole action or situation.

readingText.title: 마감이라서 할 수밖에 없어요
readingText.body: 마감이 가까우면 선택지가 줄어들어요. 이때 '할 수 없어요'라고 말하면 능력이 없거나 불가능하다는 뜻이 되지만, '할 수밖에 없어요'라고 말하면 하기 싫어도 그 방법밖에 없다는 뜻이 돼요. 반대로 '포기할 리가 없어요'는 포기할 가능성을 강하게 부정하는 말이에요. 그리고 '남은 건 이 방법뿐이에요'는 다른 선택이 없고 이 방법만 남았다는 뜻이에요. 세 표현은 모두 한계와 관련이 있지만, 각각 no choice, no way, only one이라는 다른 느낌을 가지고 있어요.
readingText.bodyTranslation: When a deadline is close, choices shrink. 할 수밖에 없어요 means there is no choice but to do it, not that you cannot do it. 리가 없어요 strongly rejects a possibility, and 뿐이에요 limits the situation to only one remaining option.

comprehensionQuestions.question: 할 수 없어요와 할 수밖에 없어요는 어떻게 달라요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 할 수 없어요는 불가능, 할 수밖에 없어요는 다른 선택이 없다는 뜻이에요.

culturalNote.title: No Choice, No Way, Only
culturalNote.body: Korean often separates the speaker's attitude from the facts of the situation. 수밖에 없다 sounds resigned to a constraint, 리가 없다 sounds confident or emotionally certain, and 뿐이다 sounds limiting or modest.
culturalNote.tip: Before choosing the pattern, label the meaning in English: no choice, no way, or only.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence means “I have no choice but to work late”?
inlineExercises.explanation: 수밖에 없다 means the situation leaves no other option.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence strongly rejects a possibility?
inlineExercises.explanation: -ㄹ 리가 없다 means there is no way that possibility is true.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence means only one method remains?
options: 남은 건 이 방법일 리가 없어요.
inlineExercises.explanation: N뿐이다 limits the situation to only that noun.

bullets: -ㄹ 수밖에 없다 = no choice but to do it.
-ㄹ 리가 없다 = there is no way that is true.
-뿐이다 = only this action, role, or option.
Do not confuse 할 수 없어요 with 할 수밖에 없어요.
